root_cause: The Portal/Powerhouse lifecycle context feature merged successfully, but Netlify production still pointed at the previous exact source SHA because the canonical Production Source Snapshot workflow only runs on a main push that touches its own workflow file.
prevention_rule: When a material Portal/website change is merged and production identity remains on an older SHA, trigger the canonical exact-source snapshot transport and require exact main SHA, production-ready deploy and Portal/production readback before terminal success.

evidence.outcome: The exact current main source is transported to Netlify and the lifecycle Portal/Brain change is only terminal after production identity and functional readback are green.
